💡 The novelty lies in synergistically combining ultrathin nanosheet morphology, NH4+ pre-intercalation, and vanadium vacancies in a layered vanadium oxide cathode. item.title: Air Stability of Cathode Prelithiation Agents for High‐Energy Lithium‐Ion Batteries: Degradation Mechanisms and Stabilization Strategies
item.description:

Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely classifies air-degradation of cathode prelithiation agents into two evidence-supported pathways—hydrolysis/carbonation of binary lithium compounds and surface-lithium loss from lithium-rich oxides—and evaluates stabilization strategies (coatings, bulk regulation, intrinsically stable materials). Its significance lies in linking lithium-compensation capability, air stability, and engineering performance, while flagging nonstandardized testing and manufacturing-compatibility gaps essential for practical high-energy lithium-ion battery implementation.

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in establishing a one-to-one stress–stoichiometry relationship at the electrode scale, despite anisotropic single-particle strain, enabling operando lithiation tracking in LFP. Its significance: mechanical stress becomes an intrinsic state variable, yielding a fast (<500 ms), accurate (<2.7% error) stress-based sensing strategy robust across temperatures and currents, providing a new framework for operando electrochemical characterization.

Small | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using ketazine bridges to link two pyridinium redox units, enabling fast, nearly simultaneous two-electron transfer that minimizes radical intermediates.
